package student

import (
	"context"
	"sort"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

type PositionUseCase struct {
	Positions repository.StudentPositionRepository
}

func (useCase PositionUseCase) ListStudentPositionIDs(ctx context.Context, studentID string) ([]int, error) {
	if useCase.Positions == nil {
		return []int{}, nil
	}
	return useCase.Positions.ListStudentPositionIDs(ctx, studentID)
}

func (useCase PositionUseCase) UpdateStudentPositionIDs(ctx context.Context, studentID string, positionIDs []int) ([]int, error) {
	if useCase.Positions == nil {
		return []int{}, nil
	}

	normalized := normalizePositionIDs(positionIDs)
	if err := useCase.Positions.ReplaceStudentPositionIDs(ctx, studentID, normalized); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return normalized, nil
}

func normalizePositionIDs(positionIDs []int) []int {
	set := make(map[int]struct{}, len(positionIDs))
	result := make([]int, 0, len(positionIDs))
	for _, positionID := range positionIDs {
		if positionID <= 0 {
			continue
		}
		if _, exists := set[positionID]; exists {
			continue
		}
		set[positionID] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, positionID)
	}
	sort.Ints(result)
	return result
}
